name: seosona-flow-local-mcp
description: Fully-local MCP server for the SEOSONA Flow Chrome extension. No login, no premium, no SEOSONA backend. Drives Google Flow via the user's own labs.google/fx tab through a localhost WebSocket bridge to the extension. Exposes generation, discovery, project, and memory tools + the Flow↔Video-AI-V2 data contract.

scripts.test: node contracts/normalize.test.mjs && node contracts/validate.mjs --self-test && node contracts/quality.test.mjs && node contracts/integration.test.mjs && node contracts/persist.test.mjs && node contracts/quality-backfill.test.mjs
